scope_of_work:
1. 5-Page Responsive Web Architecture:
- Homepage: High-converting hero section with 24/7 emergency dispatch hotline, one-tap mobile calling, instant quote request modal, customer review ratings, and trust badges (Licensed, Bonded & Insured).
- Services Page: Full showcase of Residential & Commercial Plumbing, Emergency Repairs, Drain Cleaning, Water Heater Replacement, and Sewer Line Camera Inspections.
- About Us: Company history, certified master plumber bios, service guarantee, and safety accreditations.
- Emergency Services: Dedicated urgent dispatch portal with one-tap calling, response time guarantees, and transparent pricing.
- Contact & Online Scheduling: Interactive appointment booking calendar, service radius map, Google Maps integration, and automated lead notifications.

2. Performance, Conversion & Local SEO Optimization:
- Mobile-first responsive UI built for urgent mobile callers (sticky call bar & click-to-call CTAs).
- Complete Local SEO setup with Plumber LocalBusiness schema markup and Google Business Profile optimization.
- Sub-second load speeds and WCAG AA accessibility compliance.
- Secure SSL integration, anti-spam form protections, and webhook notifications.

3. Timeline & Phased Milestones:
- Week 1: Wireframing, information architecture & copy drafting.
- Week 2: High-fidelity visual mockups & prototype approval.
- Week 3: Development, booking form integration & local SEO setup.
- Week 4: Multi-device QA audit, production deployment, and client handover.
